# TModeler

> TModeler is a Kotlin Multiplatform data engine for building data-centric applications on Android, JVM and the Web (Kotlin/Wasm, React). Declare typed models once; storage, queries, files and notifications are handled for you. The UI layer contains no business logic and no SQL. Published on Maven Central under `co.tamboai`, version 1.0.1, license EPL-2.0.

Start with the agent instructions: they cover platform choice, prerequisites, dependencies, initialization, a first model and verification.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-tmodeler/tmodeler-kmp/main/AGENTS.md): step-by-step instructions for AI coding assistants
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-tmodeler/tmodeler-kmp/main/README.md): overview, supported platforms, quick install

## Guides

- [Getting started (all platforms)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-tmodeler/tmodeler-kmp/main/docs/01-tmodeler.md): philosophy, installation, models, fields, relations, CRUD, queries, TFlow, TGate, files, features, notifications, troubleshooting, quick reference
- [Android](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-tmodeler/tmodeler-kmp/main/docs/02-android.md): Gradle, Manifest, MVVM
- [Flutter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-tmodeler/tmodeler-kmp/main/docs/03-flutter.md): Flutter to Kotlin bridge
- [React](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-tmodeler/tmodeler-kmp/main/docs/04-react.md): React + TModeler (Kotlin/Wasm), KSP registry, export contract
- [JVM](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-tmodeler/tmodeler-kmp/main/docs/05-jvm.md): desktop and server
- [iOS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-tmodeler/tmodeler-kmp/main/docs/06-ios.md): in progress

## Optional

- TBridge (synchronization), TVault (encryption) and TAi (AI) are optional modules available on request at contact@tamboai.co or https://tamboai.co. They are not on Maven Central.
- [Maven Central namespace](https://central.sonatype.com/namespace/co.tamboai)
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-tmodeler/tmodeler-kmp/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
